props.name: month
props.description: The month shown, as yyyy-mm. Pass it to control navigation.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: Starting month when uncontrolled, as yyyy-mm. Defaults to the month of `today`.

props.name: onMonthChange
props.description: Called when prev, next, today or the keyboard changes month.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: 0 starts weeks on Sunday, 1 on Monday.

props.name: maxPerDay
props.description: Chips shown in a day before the rest collapse into "+n more".

props.name: onEventClick
props.description: Called when an event chip is chosen.

props.name: onDayClick
props.description: Called when a day is clicked, or Enter is pressed on it.

props.name: today
props.description: Today, as yyyy-mm-dd. Defaults to the system date.
